name: Side
bullets: Contract Unreal Engine 5 gameplay engineering for AAA partner studios, working across C++ and Blueprint.
Combat features and abilities built on the **Gameplay Ability System**, in a project using **World Partition**.
Character and pawn setup, including animation integration.
AI behaviors and the gameplay systems they plug into.

name: Flama Craftworks
bullets: Directed the engineering and gameplay team on Timefront, an RTS / battle-royale hybrid built in Unreal Engine 5; now consult on it occasionally.

Architected extensible gameplay systems on the **Gameplay Ability System** that scale to hundreds of concurrent actors in a single session, with character animation on **vertex animation textures** (VAT) and spatial optimizations.
Profiled in **Unreal Insights** and planned the refactors that took 400 on-map characters from 8 to 60 fps.
Led the multiplayer architecture and the project refactor and migration to support it, implementing **Replication Graph** and features hands-on.
Hired and grew the gameplay engineering team: technical interviews, onboarding, and training for junior and mid engineers.
Partnered with Cinematics, VFX, Character, and Technical Art leads to land integrated gameplay features end-to-end.
Established code-review, architecture, and Git/branching standards adopted across the engineering organisation.

name: Ikonic Games
bullets: Core team developer across two unannounced action-adventure projects in Unreal Engine 5.
Established the technical foundation and gameplay architecture of the early prototypes, introducing the **Gameplay Ability System**.
Implemented systems across animation, combat, UI, and editor tooling, including character locomotion on the **Advanced Locomotion System**.
Defined the animation rules for external contracted teams, and set up **animation retargeting**, in editor and at runtime, so one set of animations works across multiple characters.
Contributed to the design and implementation of action-adventure combat, starting a combat framework that extends GAS, with AI and combat behaviors on **StateTree** and **EQS**.

name: Saber Interactive
bullets: Joined as Junior Multiplayer Programmer on Dakar Desert Rally: bugfixed and refactored multiplayer and **replication** systems to harden online play across PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X.

Promoted to Tools Programmer (Feb 2023): fixed low-level engine bugs and changed engine source to extend the editor, built **Slate** editor plugins designed for reuse across projects, and extended the **Houdini Engine** plugin for Unreal with **World Partition** streaming support.

Promoted to Tools Lead Programmer on Road Kings (May 2023): led the tools department through sprint planning, task estimates, architecture reviews, and cross-department coordination; established software architecture guidelines.
Built tools that sped up development and gave the art team an independent, creative pipeline while keeping performance in check, optimizing their assets before they reach builds and runtime.

name: Shadow Profile
bullets: Programmed gameplay features and UI across 2D, 3D, and VR Unity applications.
Built backend and database integrations for Unity-based clients.
Improved performance and architecture of existing Unity codebases.

name: Dive Studios (FEUP / Visionarium)
bullets: Led an 8-developer team on AutoRocket, an educational rocket simulator featured by Visionarium.
Planned project architecture and sprint cadence; ran high-level risk analysis.
Acted as the communication bridge between programming, art, and the external client.
